information.name: Sentiment Analysis
information.description: A divergent stacked sentiment bar chart with a separate neutral panel; both panels share one common scale. A custom tooltip is used for the non-neutral (positive, negative) responses, while a  standard Deneb/Vega-Lite tooltip is passed to the Power BI tooltip handler for the neutral responses.
information.author: Greg Philps

usermeta.title: Deneb Sentiment Analysis
usermeta.author: Greg Philps
usermeta.description: Divergent stacked sentiment bar with a separate neutral panel; all three panels share one common scale
usermeta.notes: The tooltip CARD is drawn as marks inside the panel and uses named styles for formatting: the standard Deneb/Vega-Lite tooltip passed to the Power BI tooltip handler cannot be styled, so a designed card has to be purpose-built in the spec
usermeta.template notes: usermeta object is used by the Deneb template generation process and is thus overwritten, hence added here as a comment

subtitle.expr: ['Fictitious vehicle satisfaction survey data | n = ' + pbiFormat( data('data_0')[0]['_category_total'], '#,#' ) + ' responses', 'Category and class totals may not sum to exactly 100% due to rounding']

transform.calculate: datum['_choice_class'] == 'Positive' ? pbiColor('positive', datum['_choice_bar_shade_percent']) : datum['_choice_class'] == 'Negative' ? pbiColor('negative', datum['_choice_bar_shade_percent']) : datum['_choice_class'] == 'Neutral' ? pbiColor('neutral') : 'blue'

clamp( ( datum['_tt_side'] == 1 ? datum['_tt_right_px'] : datum['_tt_left_px'] ) + datum['_tt_side'] * ( _tt_gap + _tt_width / 2 ), _tt_width / 2, _tt_panel_width - _tt_width / 2 ) - datum['_tt_label_px']

value.expr: [ pbiFormat( datum['_category_percent_decimal'], '0%' ), pbiFormat( datum['_count_of_responses'], '#,0' ), pbiFormat( datum['_category_class_percent_decimal'], '0%' ), datum['_question_group_short'] ]
